settings.title: What Phone Photos Are Costing You

settings.html:
Your competitor's website looks professional. Yours looks like it was shot on a bad day. Clients notice before they read a single word.

You are running Google Ads and social media with stock photos that could belong to any business in the country.

You have a drone-worthy property, project or product and you are showing it at ground level. Nobody sees the scale.

One shoot day fixes all of this.

settings.title: What a Shoot With MPS Delivers

settings.html:
Professional Ground Photography

Sharp, well-lit, colour-graded photos of your business, products, team, property or project. Shot for web, ads and print.

Ground Video

Smooth, gimbal-stabilised footage of your operation in action: walk-throughs, product reveals, behind-the-scenes and testimonial setups.

Drone Photography

Aerial still photos from up to 120m for property, construction, agriculture and any business where scale is part of the story.

Drone Video

Cinematic aerial footage: fly-throughs, orbit shots and establishing overviews at 5.1K. Colour-matched to ground footage.

Same-Day Previews

A selection of edited previews on the day so you know immediately what you've got.

Fully Edited Delivery

All photos retouched and colour-graded. Video edited with music, captions and transitions where applicable. Delivered as WebP (web), JPEG (print) and MP4 (social and ads).

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I need to do anything before the shoot?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: After booking we send a shot list and a simple prep guide: what areas to tidy, what to have ready, what to wear if team members will be in the photos. Most clients need about 30 minutes of preparation.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can you fly a drone anywhere?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Not everywhere. We operate under CAA regulations. Restricted zones include within 10km of controlled aerodromes, certain urban areas, and above people without permits. We check your location before confirming a drone shoot and handle permit applications where needed.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How many photos will we get?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: A half-day ground shoot typically delivers 60 to 100 edited images. A full day delivers 150 or more. Quality is the priority: we don't pad the delivery with near-identical shots.
Standard turnaround is 5 to 7 working days. Rush delivery (48 hours) is available as an add-on.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can we use the photos in our Google Ads and on social media?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. You own all files outright and can use them in any channel, at any time, without any licence fee or restriction. We recommend the WebP versions for web and ads, and the JPEG originals for print.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What if the weather is bad on the day?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: We monitor weather before every shoot. For drone shoots, wind above 40km/h or rain means we reschedule at no charge. For ground shoots, overcast is usually fine. We'll contact you the evening before if we need to move the date.
